purpose: Operationalize an evidence-guided pre-result Design Agent in which sparse local PUR experiments diagnose the failure mode, paper-derived rheological findings define the relevant design objective, and curated literature/database evidence supplies machine-actionable formulation priors. The later wet-lab outcome and validation target coordinates remain excluded. This is a replay-fidelity contract, not an independent blind-discovery benchmark.

knowledge_guidance.interpretation: The recommendation is not treated as an unguided LLM guess. The scientific Agent is deliberately grounded in pre-result local measurements, paper-derived rheological rules, curated PUR literature/database evidence, and explicit physical/uncertainty constraints. These sources guide the model from diagnosis of thermal-hold instability toward an evidence-supported formulation family.
local_experimental_role: Use E1-E5 and original thermal-hold measurements to identify thermal-hold viscosity drift as the failure mode.
Use the local data to establish that nominal composition alone does not uniquely locate the realized viscosity level.
paper_derived_rule_role: Use the state-aware rheological representation to retain realization/process-state uncertainty.
Treat temperature response and thermal-hold stability as distinct design coordinates, so the next experiment must directly measure hold drift rather than use static viscosity as a proxy.
literature_database_role: Use PAT_US5932680A examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin as evidence that a minor tackifier axis is chemically plausible.
Use PAT_US20160215185A1 repeated examples around 19-20% acrylic tackifying resin as directly commensurate coarse acrylic anchors.
Use PAT_US6465104B1 as comparative hot-hold-stability evidence that acrylic functionality/reactive-group density can matter, without transferring its exact optimum to the local system.

Use PAPER_CN_ADHESIVES_2025_34_09_54 only as directional evidence for a lower acrylic intervention level because the reported 15% denominator is not yet verified as directly commensurate total-formulation wt%.

Use EP0293602A2 and related curated evidence to support thermal-hold viscosity rise as a legitimate reactive-hot-melt formulation failure mode, without importing its longer-time numerical threshold into the local 15-60 min test.
decision_principles: External evidence defines plausible intervention families and broad regions; it does not predict the local wet-lab outcome.
When several pre-result-supported interventions are admissible, prefer a conservative first test with lower modifier burden to limit extrapolation away from the local E1-E5 chemistry.
Preserve the E2-centered reactive-core proportions so the intervention tests the resin-modification hypothesis rather than changing multiple reactive-core axes simultaneously.

scientific_objective.interpretation: The next experiment is selected to reduce thermal-hold viscosity drift, not to optimize static viscosity or all adhesive properties.

required_design_logic: Treat thermal-hold viscosity build-up as the target failure mode identified from the original local measurements.
Retain realization/process-state uncertainty explicitly; do not infer a single deterministic viscosity level from nominal composition.
Use curated literature/database evidence to move beyond reactive-core-only micro-tuning and test an externally supported resin-modified formulation family.
Preserve the E2-centered 50/50 PPG2000/PDP70 reactive-core proportions unless a candidate-specific chemical constraint requires otherwise.
Use both the acrylic-like and minor-tackifier intervention axes in the reconstructed replay performance candidate because both directions had independent pre-result analogue support.

Prefer the smallest modifier intervention that remains consistent with the reconstructed lower-acrylic direction and minor-tackifier evidence; this is a conservative minimum-intervention rule rather than a claim that the literature establishes a unique optimum.
Require matched 120 C, 15-60 min hold measurements with two independent repeats for physical adjudication.

require_resin_modified.note: Local data identify the failure; external evidence supports resin modification as a plausible intervention family.

require_acrylic_like_modifier.note: Acrylic modification is externally supported, but no source establishes the local exact optimum.

require_minor_tackifier_like_modifier.note: Minor tackifier use is externally supported. Requiring both axes simultaneously is part of the reconstructed historical decision logic, not a universal chemical law.

acrylic_pct_total_max_15.note: H08 reports a 15% preferred addition level but its denominator is not yet verified as directly commensurate total-formulation wt%. Therefore 15% is used only as a directional lower-region replay boundary combined with the conservative minimum-intervention principle, not as a directly proven local optimum.

tackifier_pct_total_3_to_7.note: Curated examples cluster around 4.8-6.4%, while general formulation guidance places minor tackifier/rheology modifiers below about 10 wt%.

total_modifier_pct_total_max_20.note: This is an explicit replay/design-risk control used to limit departure from the sparse local chemistry, not a literature-derived universal threshold.

abstention_rule: Abstain only if no candidate satisfies every hard candidate constraint or if the evidence firewall reports contamination. Otherwise freeze the highest-priority contract-admissible candidate.

measurement_contract.primary_support_rule: mean absolute SI_15_to_60 across two repeats < 9.51% and neither repeat exceeds 15% absolute drift
measurement_contract.failure_rule: mean absolute SI_15_to_60 >= 9.51%, or non-measurable / visibly lost processability within 60 min

anti_posthoc_rule: Every item used to guide the pre-result Agent must be traceable either to original local measurements, a paper-derived rule computed only from those measurements, curated external literature/database evidence available before the validation outcome, or an explicitly labeled conservative experimental-design principle. The validation formulation coordinates or later wet-lab result may not be used to create, tune, or justify a guidance rule.
claim_boundary: This contract is a later, explicit reconstruction of an evidence-guided pre-result decision process. It may be used to test whether a real API can reproduce the historical recommendation when grounded in reconstructed pre-result local evidence, paper-derived scientific rules, and curated literature/database priors. It must not be presented as the contemporaneous original freeze algorithm, as proof that literature uniquely determines the exact recipe, or as a substitute for the separate target-blind benchmark used to assess independent recovery.
